title: Idea Review Response
description: Strict response format for qualitative idea review. You MUST return exactly this JSON shape.

pass.description: True if the idea is sound and well-scoped; false if it needs significant revision (you must provide alternative_idea)

feedback.description: Qualitative evaluation in 2-4 short paragraphs: is it a good idea, well-scoped, goals/non-goals clear, constraints realistic. No implementation details.

suggested_updates.description: Concrete suggested changes as bullet points or short instructions for the editor to apply

fail_reason.description: Optional one-sentence reason when pass is false

alternative_idea.description: When pass is false: full markdown of the revised idea document (same section structure). When pass is true: empty string or brief note.
